description:
Read billed Stripe invoice-line revenue by product over a half-open issue-date window. Revenue is the sum of eligible issued invoice lines, not cash received or margin. The read preserves separate currency totals and keeps unknown or deleted catalog prices in a separate unattributed bucket; it never converts currencies. total_sales_by_currency is the complete denominator for the returned scope and includes eligible billed lines without a live catalogue product or provider price. Each product total has share_of_total_percent calculated from that denominator in percentage points with two decimals (90.16 means 90.16%); the share is null when the denominator is unavailable or zero. Product identity is the public product UUID, so two products with the same name remain separate. Product totals combine monthly and yearly variants for the same product and currency; product_intervals keeps those detail rows. No ordering or ranking is implied by this tool.

Pass from as the first issue date to include and to as the first issue date to exclude, both YYYY-MM-DD and no more than 366 days apart. scope defaults to this workspace. Pass all_my_workspaces for an unqualified WhatsApp question and whenever the person asks across their workspaces. Each workspace stays labeled. Global totals are null when a workspace is omitted, unreadable, incomplete, has no live Stripe connection, or has no successful sync; the workspace block reports that state instead of returning a zero. A processing connector with prior successful data is included and labeled refreshing; a first sync without prior successful data stays unknown. The result includes no provider call.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no workspace call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

from.description: First issue date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

scope.description: Read this workspace alone or all_my_workspaces across the authorized real workspaces of the signed-in person. Use all workspaces for an unqualified WhatsApp question and when the person asks across their workspaces.

to.description: First issue date to exclude, YYYY-MM-DD.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.
